Experience analyzing quality metrics and operational data. Strong computer and digital skills. Experience working with spreadsheets, reporting tools, or quality management systems. review_candidates.title: Human Resources Generalist
review_candidates.description: Company Description M3aarf منصة معارف is a leading educational platform and the largest provider of free education content in the Arab world. The platform focuses on making high-quality learning resources accessible to learners of all ages and backgrounds. M3aarf offers a wide range of courses and materials designed to support personal, academic, and professional development. The organization values innovation, inclusivity, and continuous improvement to better serve its growing learner community. Working at M3aarf means contributing to a mission-driven environment that aims to transform education across the region. Role Description The Human Resources Generalist will handle day-to-day HR operations for M3aarf’s team, supporting the full employee lifecycle. This full-time hybrid role is based in Cairo, Egypt, with a combination of on-site work and some work-from-home flexibility. Responsibilities include administering HR policies, managing employee records, coordinating recruitment and onboarding, and supporting performance management processes. The role also involves handling employee benefits and related inquiries, ensuring compliance with local labor regulations, and contributing to employee engagement initiatives. The HR Generalist will collaborate with managers to address HR-related issues, promote a positive work culture, and assist in HR reporting and continuous process improvement. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong foundational Human Resources (HR) knowledge, including HR Management practices. Candidates should be skilled in developing, interpreting, and implementing HR Policies in alignment with organizational and legal requirements. Candidates should have experience with Employee Benefits and Benefits Administration, ensuring accurate and timely support for team members. Relevant experience in recruitment, onboarding, and performance management, preferably in an educational or technology-focused organization. Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid environment. High level of confidentiality, attention to detail, and proficiency in HR systems or HRIS tools. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are a plus. Familiarity with Egyptian labor laws and employment regulations; fluency in Arabic and good command of English are highly beneficial.
